<thought>From the 13C NMR spectrum, the upfield signals (≈10–30 ppm) correspond to methyl carbons. The peaks at 31.31, 28.70, 27.60, 22.65, 18.60, and 14.05 ppm represent six distinct methyl carbon environments, indicating six methyl (CH₃) groups in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
